title: Learn to eFoil on the San Francisco Bay
includes: Use of wetsuit, impact vest, booties, and helmet
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Float above the water on an electric hydrofoil and carve past San Francisco’s skyline—no waves or prior surf needed. Launch into calm Crane Cove the Chase Center, where 1 on 1 coaching and premium gear make learning fast, safe, and ridiculously fun. Come fly on the bay with postcard views and an only-in-SF thrill you’ll talk about long after you dry off.
